mission: M3FV - Composable ML strategy no spend
current_commit: cdc2bea supervisor: require concrete m3fv artifact
purpose: Define the next Tiny2/Tiny3 local architecture/objective proof before any further GPU, broad training, evaluator rerun, export, promotion, or browser activation.
selected_problem: Distinguish a real held-out tiny-subproblem signal from class-collapse false progress after source, split, tensor, and command-contract checks have stopped being the common blocker.

evidence_basis.finding: Source, split, tensor, and command-contract issues are not the common failing point; repeated weak held-out transfer or prediction collapse is the dominant pattern.
Tiny2 selected table and hello from ASL Citizen high-signal region-grid, with black reserved as the Tiny3 extension.
Tiny2 train accuracy reached 1.0, but held-out validation stayed at chance, predicted hello for every held-out row, and gave table zero recall.
A region-grid true TCN memorized a deterministic tiny subset, proving capacity only; it did not prove held-out ASL recognition.
Fresh5 region-token TCN collapsed to home on validation and test with top-1 0.2 and macro-F1 0.06666666666666668.

selected_labels.do_not_expand_to: Fresh5, 25-label, 75-label, or 95-label recognizer runs from this contract.

future_local_command_contract.reason_runner_repair_is_needed: The existing M3EM runner is pinned to the M3EM receipt path and Tiny2-only probe. A future slice should make an M3FW-style runner or equivalent contract-bound wrapper instead of rerunning M3EM as-is.

objective_and_architecture_constraints.architecture_selection_rule: Choose one architecture before execution and record why it is the smallest falsifiable test; do not compare multiple architectures in the same future slice.
objective_and_architecture_constraints.objective_selection_rule: The future proof must report train fit, held-out accuracy, macro-F1, per-label recall, predicted-label distribution, dominant-class share, and label-shuffle or equivalent false-progress control.

entry_gates_for_future_execution: GOAL.md must point at a future prompt that explicitly authorizes this local/no-spend proof.
git status must be clean except scoped future-run files.
brev ls --json must be read-only and show no authorized running paid worker for this proof.
web/public/model/model-card.json must remain status not_trained before and after.
docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json must keep activeLabels empty before and after.

false_progress_controls: If all held-out predictions collapse to one label, the proof fails even when train accuracy passes.
If label-shuffle or equivalent control also passes the held-out gates, the proof fails as a leakage or objective-validity blocker.
If Tiny2 fails, do not run Tiny3, Fresh5, 25-label, 75-label, or 95-label expansion under the same prompt.

explicit_non_authorizations: No Brev start, exec, sync, copy, stop, or remote command.
No Detector 0 runtime authority, export, promotion, browser recognition activation, active vocabulary promotion, or model-card promotion.
No source import, source-register mutation, manifest mutation, tensor mutation, packet mutation, or vocabulary mutation.
No pretrained detector, landmark model, backbone, embedding, generated label, pseudo-label, or teacher-logit path.
